simple.meaning: חָשִׂף (châsiph) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, drawn off , i.e. separated ; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָשִׂף (H2835) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָשִׂף (H2835) before moving outward to related references.
